description: Cheapest one-way fares by month for a route from Slashtel's flight fare tracker: price, airline and stops for each of the next 12 months on tracked routes (or the next 3 months on any other route), with the cheapest month. Pass IATA airport or city codes (LON, DEL, DXB, NYC, YTO, MNL...). Slashtel does not sell flights; fares are found in GBP from cached fare data and the airline charges in its own currency. Includes a source page to cite.

destination.description: IATA airport or city code, e.g. DEL, LOS, MNL

origin.description: IATA airport or city code, e.g. LON, NYC, DXB

name: get_flight_fares
title: Get flight fares by month
